175: class StringTokenizer(BaseTokenizer[StrOrBytes]):
176:     """Tokenizer for string and bytes types."""

178:     def __init__(self, encoding: str = "utf-8", normalizer: Callable[[str], str] | None = None) -> None:
179:         self.encoding = encoding
180:         self.normalizer = normalizer or (lambda x: x)
181: 
182:     def tokenize(self, value: StrOrBytes) -> Token:
183:         if isinstance(value, bytes):
184:             str_value = value.decode(self.encoding)
185:         else:
186:             str_value = value

cat > /tmp/SmokeTest.scala <<'EOF'
import tokenizer._

object SmokeTest {
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = {
    // TokenType
    assert(TokenType.STRING.value == "string")
    println("TokenType: OK")

    // Token
    val t = Token("hi", TokenType.STRING, Map("k" -> 1))
    assert(t.withMetadata("y" -> true).value == "hi")
    assert(t.withMetadata("y" -> true).metadata("y") == true)
    println("Token: OK")

    // TokenContainer
    val container = new TokenContainer(Seq("a", "b", "c"))
    assert(container.getAll == Vector("a", "b", "c"))
    assert(container.mapTokens(_.toUpperCase) == List("A", "B", "C"))
    println("TokenContainer: OK")

    // TokenSink
    val sink = new TokenSink[String]()
    sink.receive("hello")
    sink.receive("world")
    assert(sink.drain() == List("hello", "world"))
    assert(sink.drain().isEmpty)
    println("TokenSink: OK")

    // BivariantHandler
    val h = new BivariantHandler[Int](0)
    h.set(5)
    assert(h.get == 5)
    assert(h.transform(_ * 2) == 10)
    println("BivariantHandler: OK")

    // MutableTokenBatch
    val batch = new MutableTokenBatch()
    batch.add(Token("x", TokenType.STRING))
    batch.markProcessed()
    try { batch.add(Token("y", TokenType.STRING)); assert(false) }
    catch { case _: RuntimeException => () }
    println("MutableTokenBatch: OK")

    // BaseTokenizer subclasses
    val st = new StringTokenizer()
    assert(st.tokenize("hello").tokenType == TokenType.STRING)
    println("StringTokenizer: OK")

    val nt = new NumericTokenizer(precision = 3)
    val ntok = nt.tokenize(BigDecimal("3.14159"))
    assert(ntok.value == "3.142", s"got ${ntok.value}")
    println("NumericTokenizer: OK")

    val tt = new TemporalTokenizer()
    val ldt = LocalDateTime.of(2024, 1, 15, 10, 30, 0)
    assert(tt.tokenize(ldt).tokenType == TokenType.TEMPORAL)
    println("TemporalTokenizer: OK")

    // UniversalTokenizer
    val ut = new UniversalTokenizer()
    assert(ut.tokenizeNull.tokenType == TokenType.NULL)
    assert(ut.tokenizeNull.value == "NULL")
    assert(ut.tokenize(42).tokenType == TokenType.NUMERIC)
    assert(ut.tokenize("hello").tokenType == TokenType.STRING)
    println("UniversalTokenizer: OK")

    // TokenRegistry
    val reg = new TokenRegistry[String]()
    reg.register("greeting", new TokenContainer(Seq("hi", "hello")))
    val handler: String => Option[Token] = s => Some(Token(s, TokenType.STRING))
    reg.addHandler(handler)
    val results = reg.process("greeting")
    assert(results.length == 2)
    assert(results.forall(_.isDefined))
    println("TokenRegistry: OK")

    // TokenFunctor / TokenMonad
    val f = new TokenFunctor(5)
    assert(f.map(_ * 2).value == 10)
    val m = new TokenMonad(3)
    val pm = m.ap(new TokenMonad((x: Int) => x + 10))
    assert(pm.value == 13)
    println("TokenFunctor/TokenMonad: OK")

    // JsonTokenizer
    val jt = new JsonTokenizer()
    val jtok = jt.tokenize(Map("a" -> 1, "b" -> List(1, 2, 3)))
    println("JsonTokenizer token: " + jtok.value)
    assert(jtok.tokenType == TokenType.STRUCTURED)
    val pathTok = jt.tokenizePath(Map("a" -> Map("b" -> 42)), "a.b")
    assert(pathTok.exists(_.value.contains("42")))
    println("JsonTokenizer: OK")

    // WhitespaceTokenizer
    val ws = new WhitespaceTokenizer(lowercase = true, minLength = 2)
    val wsTokens = ws.tokenize("Hello World Foo")
    assert(wsTokens.exists(_.value == "hello"))
    println("WhitespaceTokenizer: OK")

    // TokenizerBuilder
    val builder = new TokenizerBuilder[Int]()
    val fn = builder
      .withNormalizer((s: String) => s.toUpperCase)
      .withValidator((n: Int) => n >= 0)
      .withMetadata("source" -> "test")
      .build()
    val btok = fn(42)
    assert(btok.value == "42")
    assert(btok.tokenType == TokenType.STRING)
    assert(btok.metadata("source") == "test")
    println("TokenizerBuilder: OK")

    // Top-level functions
    val top = tokenize(123)
    assert(top.tokenType == TokenType.NUMERIC)
    val batchTop = tokenizeBatch(List(1, 2, 3))
    assert(batchTop.length == 3)
    println("Top-level tokenize: OK")

    println("\nAll smoke tests passed.")
  }
}
EOF
